Version: see package.json
Source: @fortawesome/fontawesome-free
Path: static/vendor/fontawesome-free/
License: LICENSE.txt (CC-BY-4.0 AND OFL-1.1 AND MIT)
Bump: npm pack @fortawesome/fontawesome-free in a temp dir; replace this folder with package/ contents; keep this NOTICE if useful.
Future: optional Hugo module (not core haz). Bootstrap Icons can be a sibling module later.
Currently loaded: css/all.min.css (webfonts). SVGs available under svgs/ for later mask/inline use.
